xyy.skill.jn50401.name: 赠剑
xyy.skill.jn50401.rule: during his own action phase, the owner may transfer exactly one equipped item to another living player, replacing that target's same-slot equipment, then immediately draw two; each target may be chosen only once in that action phase
xyy.skill.jn50401.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, equipped weapon/armor candidates, other-living target validation, same-slot replacement before deterministic draw-two, per-action target memory, repeat use on different targets, optional timeout, JSON replay, SQLite final restart and six-socket draw privacy

xyy.skill.jn50402.name: 剑匣
xyy.skill.jn50402.rule: when the native skill is loaded, the owner's hand limit is five instead of three; discard is required only above five
xyy.skill.jn50402.verifiedBoundary: native ownership graph, setup application, authoritative discard decisions at five and six cards, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket public projection

xyy.skill.jn50501.name: 凝冰焚炎
xyy.skill.jn50501.rule: when a batch contains at least one positive water or fire item targeting the owner, remove every water or fire owner item without IMMUNE_INVAO from that batch, including zero-value siblings
xyy.skill.jn50501.verifiedBoundary: per-item water/fire immunity, thunder non-match, IMMUNE_INVAO bypass, mixed targets, JSON replay, SQLite restart, six-socket response isolation and resumed damage

xyy.skill.jn20202.name: 拒绝
xyy.skill.jn20202.rule: while a normal TP01 is legal, the owner may pay any own TP-category hand card as TP01 and enter the same nested cancellation chain
xyy.skill.jn20202.verifiedBoundary: TP-category filtering, ordinary-card rejection, physical payment, canonical cancel-effect child, nested counter, timeout pass, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn40301.name: 烹饪
xyy.skill.jn40301.rule: the owner may pay exactly two distinct own hand cards as TP02, using its normal cancellable self-heal mode during action or its direct current-target rescue mode during dying
xyy.skill.jn40301.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, exact two-card payment, action TP02 response chain, rescue priority, cure modifiers, timeout pass, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn20302.name: 元灵归心术
xyy.skill.jn20302.rule: during her own action phase, the owner may repeatedly discard exactly one own JP-category hand card to directly cure any living player by two
xyy.skill.jn20302.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, JP filtering, any living target including self/full HP, repeat use, direct non-cancellable cure, equipment modifier, timeout no-payment, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn40401.name: 饕餮
xyy.skill.jn40401.rule: during her own action phase, the owner may repeatedly discard exactly one own hand card, weapon or armor, then directly cure herself by two
xyy.skill.jn40401.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, hand/weapon/armor zones, exact payment, discard-before-cure ordering, retained versus paid WQ02, repeat use, timeout no-payment, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn50201.name: 搜囊探宝
xyy.skill.jn50201.rule: once during her own action phase, the owner may pay exactly one own hand card as either JP01 or JP06, then use the canonical cancellable card and hidden-choice chain
xyy.skill.jn50201.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, exact hand payment, JP01/JP06 mode and target validation, once-per-turn state, Bingxin cancellation, opaque choice, deterministic timeout reuse, JSON replay, SQLite window/choice restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn50202.name: 劫富济贫
xyy.skill.jn50202.rule: once during her own action phase, the owner draws one card; if her actual hand count after the draw attempt is at least two, she must discard exactly one eligible own hand card
xyy.skill.jn50202.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, zero-input activation, deterministic draw and refill reuse, post-draw threshold, owner-only mandatory choice, seeded timeout, once-per-turn state, JSON replay, SQLite choice/final restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn50203.name: 盗墓
xyy.skill.jn50203.rule: after one simultaneous death batch containing at least one other player with cards, the living owner collects every dead player's hand and equipment, may distribute any captured cards among other living players, retains the remainder, then takes one ordinary neutral self-damage
xyy.skill.jn50203.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, whole-batch death timing, owner-death and victory skip, hand/equipment collection, optional repeated distribution, retain remainder, canonical self-damage response and recursive dying, 15-second/disconnect pass, JSON replay, SQLite loot/reaction restart and six-socket privacy

decisions.ownershipRepresentation: complete static hero-to-skill graph checked byte-for-byte against generated catalog dependencies
decisions.activeSkillRepresentation: native passive lookup is derived from authoritative heroId; dynamic gain/loss state is introduced only when a migrated rule requires it
decisions.jn50402Timing: apply hand limit five atomically when setup finalizes XJ404, matching native G0IS skill loading
decisions.jn50402Visibility: hand limit is public match state; hand identities remain owner-only
decisions.futureHeroChanges: any later hero transformation or dynamic skill ownership node must call the same skill-derived stat recomputation before it can be verified
decisions.jn50401TargetMemory: the legacy RAM Present collection is represented as serialized turn.usedSkillTargetIds for JN50401, preserved across action-phase restarts and omitted when the next turn is created
decisions.jn50401TransferOrdering: the authoritative activation event removes the selected owner equipment, equips it to the target and discards any replaced same-slot item before a second event uses the canonical deterministic draw-two planner; a replacement can therefore enter an empty-pile refill
decisions.jn50401RepeatAndTimeout: ONCE 0 permits repeated use while another equipped card and unused other living target exist; generic optional action timeout ends action without moving equipment or drawing
decisions.jn50401Visibility: equipment movement and public hand counts are visible to all seats, while the two drawn instance ids remain only in the owner's hand projection
decisions.jn50401ScopedEquipment: legacy ListOutAllEquips also understands extra and fake equipment, but the standard plus Fengmingyushi runtime has only physical weapon and armor slots and no scoped fake-equipment producer; broader special-card compatibility is not claimed
decisions.jn20202ConversionRepresentation: the paid physical TP-category card and JN20202 source are recorded while the child uses the canonical cancel-effect node shared by normal TP01
decisions.jn20202Timeout: conversion is optional and the existing 15-second reaction timeout is a pass without payment
decisions.jn40301ConversionRepresentation: one command carries the exact two physical payment cards and skill source; action mode creates the canonical TP02 effect while rescue mode enters the existing dying cure path
decisions.jn40301ChoiceProjection: the owner sees one authoritative action with all own eligible hand cards and requiredCardCount two, avoiding quadratic pair enumeration
decisions.jn40301Timeout: both uses are optional; action timeout ends action and rescue timeout passes without paying cards
decisions.activeSkillCommand: active hero skills use a narrow command carrying selected physical cards, target players and a server-validated skill id; each migrated skill owns its exact validation and event semantics
decisions.jn20302Resolution: discard and cure are one authoritative turn event; it does not create a card effect or reaction window because legacy calls Cure directly rather than G0CC
decisions.jn20302RepeatAndTimeout: there is no per-turn marker; the action remains available while another JP hand card exists, and generic optional action timeout ends the phase without payment
decisions.jn40401ZoneRepresentation: the projected candidate list is own hand followed by weapon and armor; the event records the authoritative source zone so replay removes exactly one physical instance
decisions.jn40401Ordering: payment state is constructed before cure planning, matching legacy G0QZ before Cure; a paid WQ02 gives no bonus while a retained WQ02 still does
decisions.jn40401RepeatAndTimeout: there is no per-turn marker; the action remains available while any own hand/equipment card exists, and timeout ends action without payment
decisions.jn50201ConversionRepresentation: the command and event record the paid physical hand card, native skill id and selected virtual JP01/JP06 id; both modes reuse the canonical cancellable effect and hidden card-zone choice state machine
decisions.jn50201OnceState: usedSkillIds is serialized on the current turn, consumed when the conversion effect starts even if Bingxin later cancels it, and reset only when a new turn is created
decisions.jn50201TargetProjection: JP01 lists living opponents with hand cards; JP06 lists living targets that retain at least one selectable card after the chosen source payment, while the legacy global requirement that another player has any card remains authoritative
decisions.jn50201Timeout: activation is optional so the action timeout pays nothing; after activation the existing mandatory card-zone choice uses deterministic seeded random fallback
decisions.jn50202AtomicResolution: one authoritative event records the deterministic draw result, consumes the per-turn marker and opens a serializable owner-only choice only when the actual post-draw hand count is at least two
decisions.jn50202ChoiceAndTimeout: the pending choice contains every current own hand instance, requires exactly one discard and uses the shared deterministic seeded random timeout; no reaction window is opened
decisions.jn50202ProtectedCardsScope: legacy G0DH excludes Board.ProtectedTux, but the only known producer is special hero SP301 outside standard plus Fengmingyushi; the scoped runtime has no protected-card state, so all scoped hand cards are eligible and broader special-hero compatibility is not claimed
decisions.jn50203BatchTiming: death zones are retained until the complete simultaneous dying batch is known; JN50203 runs once after every death has been marked but is skipped when the owner also died or that batch already reduced living teams to one
decisions.jn50203CollectionAndDistribution: all dead hands plus weapon and armor are atomically moved into the owner hand; only captured instances remain selectable for repeated owner-only transfers to any other living player, and finishing early retains every unassigned instance
decisions.jn50203Timeout: distribution is optional, so each 15-second deadline and the disconnected auto-decision finish immediately without transferring another card; each completed transfer opens a fresh 15-second choice deadline
decisions.jn50203SelfDamage: finishing or exhausting the captured set creates one ordinary neutral self-damage through the canonical response pipeline, so TP03/FJ05 and a subsequent dying batch remain available exactly as for other damage
decisions.jn50203Visibility: captured instance ids exist only in the owner's hand, pending choice and availableActions; all other views expose public counts and empty dead zones without revealing the captured identities
decisions.jn50203ProtectedCardsScope: legacy G0HQ type 1 excludes Board.ProtectedTux, but the scoped standard plus Fengmingyushi runtime has no protected-card producer; every scoped dead hand/equipment instance is therefore collectible, without claiming compatibility with out-of-scope special heroes
